4: Freya wants to count everything in the lighthouse! One sun in the window, two shoes by the door, three birds on the roof, four spoons on the table. Pip helps her — but Pip counts the same fish five times, so the numbers are always wrong! How many books can you see? How many hands have you got? Count with Freya from one to ten, and then count everything in YOUR room!
5: Astrid opens her school bag and puts everything in its place: this is her pen, this is her red pencil, this is her book, and this is her ruler. Everything is tidy — Astrid loves tidy things! But look at her chair… Pip is sleeping on it again, on top of the crayons. This is my chair, says Astrid. This is MY chair, says Pip. What is in YOUR school bag? Open it and say it in English!
6: Colour hunt in the lighthouse! Nico looks for something red and finds an apple. He looks for something blue and finds the sea from the window. He looks for something green and finds… a green sock under the bed! And Pip? Pip finds something black and white: himself, in the mirror. What colour is your bag? What colour is your door? Look around you and say the colours with Nico!
7: Tomás cannot sit still today! He has got two arms, two legs, two feet and one very fast body — and he wants to move all of them. Head, arms, hands, legs, feet: he touches them one by one and then jumps up again. Pip has got two little wings and one orange beak, so he tries the game too. What have YOU got? Touch your head, touch your nose, and let's move with Tomás!
8: Funny faces game! Freya makes big round eyes, a small nose and an enormous smile. Then Nico tries: he has got one eye open, one eye closed and his teeth outside. He always wins this game! She has got a nice smile, he has got a very silly one. Look at your friend's face: what has he got? What has she got? Make a funny face and play with Freya and Nico!
9: Dress-up day at school! Astrid is wearing her green dress, her white socks and her favourite hat. Tomás is wearing a red t-shirt, blue trousers and one shoe — the other shoe is lost! They look for it in the classroom, in the garden and under the table. What are YOU wearing today? A jacket? Shorts? Say it in English and join the dress-up day!
10: Welcome to Nico's house! Come in: this is the kitchen, where the bread smells wonderful. This is the bedroom, this is the bathroom, and here is the door to the garden. Where is Pip? He is not in the kitchen. He is not in the garden. He is in the bathroom, in the water, very happy! Where is the door of YOUR house? Let's visit every room with Nico.
11: Freya's bedroom is her little world. There is a small bed with a blue blanket, there is a yellow lamp, there is a clock on the wall and there is a big toy box in the corner. And there is one puffin under the pillow — Pip again! Is he sleeping? Yes, he is. What is in YOUR bedroom? Is there a lamp? Is there a picture? Come in and look with Freya!
12: Lunch time in the lighthouse! Tomás likes chicken and rice, and he eats it very fast. Nico doesn't like fish, so he puts it under his bread — but everybody sees it! Then comes the cake, and now Nico likes everything again. Pip likes ice cream, cheese, eggs… Pip likes food. What do YOU like? What don't you like? Sit down at the table and tell us!
13: Fruit salad day! Astrid brings two apples and three bananas, and Freya brings one enormous watermelon that she can hardly carry. They cut the oranges, they mix the grapes and the strawberries, and the kitchen smells like summer. One mango, two mangoes, three mangoes — say them all! Which fruit do you like best? Bring it to the table and make the salad with them!
14: After football Nico and Tomás are SO thirsty! Can I have some water, please? says Tomás, and he drinks a big glass in one second. Can I have a lemonade? says Nico. And then, in a small voice: can I have a hot chocolate too? Pip only wants the cup — to sit in it. What can YOU ask for when you are thirsty? Say it politely and try it with your friends!
15: Pet day at school! Freya has got a little brown rabbit with very long ears. Astrid has got two orange fish in a glass bowl. Have you got a dog? Have you got a cat? Everybody shows their pet — and then everybody looks at Pip, the only puffin in the class, sitting on the teacher's table like a king. Have YOU got a pet? Tell us its name!
16: Farm trip! The bus stops and Tomás runs to the animals. It is a cow — moo! It is a duck — quack! It is a sheep, it is a horse, it is a very pink pig in the mud. The grass is wet and everybody's shoes are dirty. Pip is talking to the hens, and the hens answer him! It is a hen, says Tomás, laughing. What animals live on a farm? Come and hear them all!
17: Zoo day is the best day! Nico and Astrid stop in front of the elephant: it is SO big! Then the monkey, small and funny, jumps from tree to tree. The giraffe is very tall, the hippo is very fat, and the snake is long and quiet. The lion can roar, the monkey can climb, and the tiger can run. What can the animals do? Come with them and find out!
18: The sea is Pip's home. Freya sits on the sand and looks: there is one little boat, there are three white waves, there are two crabs walking sideways and there is a star under the water. There are shells everywhere, and Freya puts the best ones in her pocket. Pip is on a rock, very serious, like a small sea captain. What is in the sea? Look and say it with Freya!
19: Astrid and Nico sit in the square and look at the people. There is a man with a big dog. There is a woman with yellow flowers. There are three children playing with a ball, and there is a baby sleeping in his mother's arms. A man, a woman, a boy, a girl — every person has a story. Who can YOU see in your street? Sit down and look with them!
20: This is my best friend, says Tomás. His name is Nico and his jokes are terrible — that is why we laugh! Freya smiles: this is my friend too. Her name is Astrid and she is very kind, she always shares her crayons. Friends play together, friends share, friends are funny. What is YOUR friend's name? Say his name, say her name, and tell us why he or she is special!
21: Nico plays the opposites game and he never gets it right! The elephant is big, the mouse is small. This road is long, that pencil is short. His shoes are dirty, his sister's shoes are clean. My jacket is old, says Nico, and my hat is… old too! Pip looks at him: the puffin is small, but his beak is big. Big or small? Long or short? Play the game and say the opposite!
22: Faces tell stories. Freya is happy today, because it is Friday. Tomás is hungry — he is always hungry — and his stomach makes noises in class. Nico is tired, Astrid is a little angry because her pencil is broken, and Pip is thirsty. Are you happy? Are you sad? I am fine, thank you! How do YOU feel today? Show your face and tell us!
23: I can jump! says Tomás, and he jumps. I can run! And he runs. I can swim, I can climb, I can dance — badly, but I can dance! Pip looks at him and opens his wings: I can fly, and you can't! True. But Pip can't ride a bicycle, and Tomás can. Everybody can do something. What can YOU do? Show us — and then find something you can't do yet!
24: Action time with Nico and Freya! Walk, walk, walk… STOP! Look at the window. Listen to the birds. Clap your hands three times. Turn around. Touch your nose. Point at something blue. Nico always does the wrong one and everybody laughs, and then everybody starts again. This is the moving class, the favourite class of the week. Stand up: can you follow all the actions?
25: Where is the little red car? Astrid can't find it anywhere. Is it in the toy box? No. Is it on the table? No. Is it under the chair? No! Is it under the bed, with the socks and the dust? Yes — and Pip is under the bed too, sitting on the car like an egg. In, on, under: three small words that find everything. Where are YOUR things? Let's look for them!
26: Look around the classroom: Freya is drawing a big blue whale. Astrid is writing the date on the board. Nico is counting his crayons — one, two, five, seven — no, Nico! And Tomás is cutting paper for everybody. Everyone is doing something different at the same time. What is your friend doing right now? Look, point and say it in English!
27: GOOOAL! Tomás scores and the whole team shouts. He plays football at break, basketball after school and he swims on Mondays. Nico prefers tennis, because you can play it with only one friend. Let's play! says Tomás every single day, with the ball already in his hands. What sport do YOU play? Choose your team and come to the field!
28: The park after school is the best place in the world. Freya goes up the slide and comes down very fast. Nico is on the swing, higher and higher. There is a big old tree with birds, there are flowers next to the bench, and the grass is soft and green. Let's play hide and seek! says Freya. One, two, three… Where can YOU play near your house? Let's go to the park!
